decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are a thermoforming material that builds directly on the firm's core dental lab material know-how, and the firm can readily interpret lab feedback on them.
PETG thermoforming blanks sit squarely within the firm's established thermoforming competence and draw on in-house R&D, so learning and improvement are easy.

A UV-curing lacquer relates to the firm's light-curing materials expertise, but its weaker website presence suggests a niche consumable that may be consolidated, so it carries a moderate risk of being dropped.
An intraoral contrast spray supports the firm's push into digital scanning workflows and complements its digital manufacturing direction, though it lies somewhat outside its core materials base.
Custom earmolds are a core competence of the firm's hearing-care business with skilled custom-device manufacturing, so it can absorb market feedback well.
Custom hearing protection earmolds draw on the same earmold manufacturing know-how and digital production, extending into an adjacent market the firm understands.
